app.name: GAF Calculator
app.description:
A GAF asphalt-shingle takeoff, priced. The measurements a GAF report gives go in at the top, each carrying the job’s waste allowance; the system comes out the bottom as labor, materials with tax, the price to the client, profit and margin.

Every line is a quantity, a price and a total, and every one of them is editable. These are the lines a re-roof usually has — they are not the prices any company charges. Put your own prices in once, on a takeoff you keep.

Quantities are typed, not derived. A calculation’s answer is never stored, so it cannot feed another box: each quantity field says in its placeholder which measurement it comes off ("{Total SQ + waste} x 3 bundles per square"), and the waste rows above are there to be read off while filling them in.

Sister app to Underwriting Calculator, which prices tile. The measurements are the same eight plus Hips — a shingle roof caps hips as well as ridges.
